info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Status API provides real-time status updates for rides within a ridesharing platform. Developers can utilize this API to retrieve information about ongoing, completed, or canceled rides, offering transparency to riders and drivers. Typical consumers include mobile app developers, web services, and integration platforms that enhance user experience by displaying ride statuses. This API ensures efficient communication of ride details, aiding in the management of rideshare operations, and improving service reliability.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a specified ride. It provides essential information about the ride's progress and any relevant updates.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the current status of the rides. The body of the request should contain the necessary parameters to specify which rides' statuses are being queried.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the current ride status is returned.

ListRideshareRidesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on rides status. It is expected to be a string value that conveys necessary information.

ListRideshareRidesStatusResponse_200.title: Ride Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the ride reference.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListRideshareRidesStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the ride status operation, detailing the status and various metadata of the ride.
